name: guardian-listeners
description: Port of the old Guardian extension's #1 priority piece per GUARDIAN-ARCHIVE-MINING-2026-08-23.md: 'the social-media listener pattern (base-module.js + instagram.js/threads.js) — real, working, most substantial.' Reimplements the GuardianModule (MutationObserver -> emit()) pattern as real userscripts, wired into the SAME guardian.listener.start/guardian.listener.event protocol clear-glass/renderer/guardian-picker.js (TX14) already established, so detected events route through the identical, already-real listener-config-modal destinations (ledger, compartment, sse-to-system, ollama-stream). Includes the old extension's single/double-tap ESC killswitch pattern (item 3 of the same mining report): single ESC stops this module locally, a second ESC within 1.5s triggers a real full stop of every active Guardian listener userscript via ipc/bridge.js's _fullStopGuardianListeners.
author: James Brooks (Erosmancer)
